# TEDxAuburnHills

TEDxAuburnHills presents Retooling: Same hands, different tools, a public TEDx event on October 10, 2026, at the OU Pavilion in Rochester, Michigan. The event runs from 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Eastern time; everyone must leave by 5:00 p.m. The event brings together twelve speakers across technology, medicine, art, history, recreation, and community change. In-person registration is free and limited to 100 guests, with a free livestream planned.
